description: This file contains a test class for acceptance testing of the Surveys module in SuiteCRM, using the Codeception testing framework. It sets up fake data generation, performs a login, navigates to the Surveys list view, and verifies that the module title is visible.

classes.name: SurveysCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Surveys module, utilizing Faker for fake data and performing UI interactions to verify module accessibility.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, initializes Faker generator and seeds fake data.

methods.name: testScenarioViewSurveysModule
methods.description: Test scenario that logs in as admin, navigates to the Surveys module, and verifies that the module title appears on the page.
